text: The Colloquy of the Elders is an Irish text written in the 12th century, likely by Christian monks. It is a key source for the tales of the Fianna. Two survivors of the band, Oisín and Caílte, come back from a long stay in another world and meet Saint Patrick. They argue about faith and values with him. Then the two old men travel with the monk, point out the holy places, and tell the tales tied to each site. The book was written in Christian times, yet it mocks Patrick and treats the last men of pagan Ireland with honor.

okr.objective: The Colloquy pairs two old Fianna warriors with Saint Patrick and honors the dying pagan world.
